verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents an official hosted MCP server that external AI assistants connect to. That is the server role and does not show Honeybadger itself consuming tools from MCP servers users plug in. A monitoring platform with built-in AI features (such as its natural-language search) could plausibly act as an MCP client, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never shows Honeybadger doing so.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
